sections.title: 1. Introduction
body: This Privacy Policy (the “Policy”) is intended to inform Users about how Águila collects, uses, stores, processes, and protects personal and non-personal information obtained through the Platform.

sections.title: 2. Information Collected
body: In general, the Platform does not require Users to provide personal data to access the available information. However, Águila may collect, directly or indirectly, if the User chooses to do so: name, email address, phone number, consumption preferences, interaction history, and other data the User voluntarily provides.
Technical data may also be collected automatically, such as IP address, device type, operating system, browser used, cookies, and browsing statistics.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
body: The information collected may be used, among other purposes:
points: To improve the User’s experience on the Platform.
To send communications, promotions, or news, subject to the User’s prior consent.
To conduct statistical, market, or behavioral studies.
To comply with legal provisions or requests from competent authorities.

sections.title: 4. Consent and Transfers
body: Use of the Platform implies the User’s express consent to the processing of their information in accordance with this Policy. Under no circumstances will Águila sell, assign, or transfer personal data to third parties without prior authorization, except in the case of a legal obligation or court order. Data may be stored on servers located inside or outside the national territory, under reasonable security standards.

sections.title: 5. Information Security
body: Águila adopts reasonable technical, administrative, and organizational measures to protect User data against unauthorized access, alteration, loss, or destruction. However, the User acknowledges that no system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 6. User Rights
body: The User may, at any time, exercise their rights to access, rectify, update, and delete data, in accordance with Argentine Personal Data Protection Law No. 25,326 and, where applicable, the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: 7. Changes to the Policy
body: Águila may modify, update, or replace this Policy at any time. It shall be understood that the User accepts such changes by continuing to use the Platform after their publication.
